featured_reviews.name: Abhijna Goutham P
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank Priya Mam enough for the incredible transformation she brought into my life!
I approached her when I was struggling with very low blood pressure (around 80/60), persistent constipation, and overall low energy. Instead of just pushing a quick fix, Priya Mam thoughtfully guided me to consult Dr. Smitha Nambiar (who is also our family doctor). Dr. Smitha recommended a few tests, which revealed that my cholesterol and triglycerides were surprisingly on the higher side, along with low Vitamin D.
Dr. Smitha suggested Vitamin D supplements and advised me to follow Priya Mam’s guidance for the rest. Priya Mam crafted a practical, sustainable diet plan with smart changes to my eating habits and simple exercise recommendations. I followed everything consistently for just one month..nothing extreme, just consistent good habits like increased water intake and better food choices.
Out of curiosity, I got my lipid profile rechecked after one month and one week… and the results left us all amazed! My triglycerides and cholesterol levels had dropped beautifully within normal limits. My energy levels are now consistently high, my periods are smooth and hassle-free, and — best of all — constipation is no longer a daily battle.
Priya Mam truly excels at helping people manage and reverse lifestyle-related issues through realistic habit changes. She doesn’t just give diets; she empowers you to take control of your health.
I’m committed to continuing these habits and I strongly recommend Priya Mam to anyone dealing with lifestyle diseases, low energy, digestive issues, hormonal imbalances, or lipid problems. She is genuinely life-changing. Thank you, Priya Mam , you are a blessing!
